\section{Background}
Kinase inhibitors remain a cornerstone of targeted cancer therapy,
but acquired resistance limits the duration of the clinical response.
Structure-guided optimisation aims to improve selectivity early in a campaign,
before expensive synthesis commitments are made.

\section{Compound Series}
Our starting series shows potent activity against the target kinase
and measurable off-target activity against two closely related kinases.
The selectivity window must improve substantially
before a candidate can advance to tolerability studies.
